d: Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You independently operate and maintain at leas one process or equipment or systems following autonomous maintenance (AM) standards and use your technical skills to improve line and/or system performance to meet business needs.
q: A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Machine operations, TPM-Total Productive Maintenance Tools
Safety and quality standards for operating machinery
Reading and writing and fluently conversant in the language of communication as appropriate to the site
Collaborating well in a diverse work environment
Understanding of total productive maintenance tools and methodologies a distinct advantage

Mondelēz International in the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan serves the Middle East and Africa markets as well as Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we have more than 2600 employees working across seven plants and six commercial offices; we make, bake, sell and deliver our products to customers. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
r: You are a key ingredient in changing how the world snacks. You will operate and maintains equipment to meet our safety, quality, cost, delivery, sustainability and morale targets. You will execute all standard work processes using AM and PM (progressive maintenance standards). In this role, you will ensure that safety processes are observed, and that quality assurance activities are performed. You will take an active role in shutdown maintenance, root-cause analysis, stops reductions loss analysis and breakdown elimination.

d: Company Description The Bahrain Influencers is a platform dedicated to showcasing Bahrain’s businesses, entrepreneurs, industry leaders, innovators, influencers, and success stories. Its mission is to highlight inspiring journeys, promote local brands, and connect professionals, organizations, and communities across the Kingdom of Bahrain. Through business spotlights, leadership features, startup stories, industry insights, and community highlights, the platform builds a network that celebrates achievement and supports growth. The Bahrain Influencers offers a space for business owners, corporate leaders, content creators, and professionals to share their stories, increase visibility, and inspire others. By connecting Bahrain’s visionaries with wider audiences, the platform contributes to the country’s evolving business and innovation landscape.

Role Description The Social Media Marketing & Business Growth Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Manama. This role is responsible for planning, creating, and publishing social media content across platforms to showcase Bahrain’s businesses, visionaries, and success stories. The specialist will manage social media calendars, run campaigns, and monitor performance analytics to drive audience engagement and brand visibility. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with featured businesses and professionals, developing digital marketing strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and supporting partnerships that expand the platform’s reach. The role also involves community interaction, responding to messages and comments, and aligning all online activities with The Bahrain Influencers’ mission of promoting local achievement and connection.
q: Strong skills in Social Media Marketing and Digital Marketing, with experience developing and executing online growth strategies.
Ability to plan and produce Social Media Content Creation, including visuals and copy tailored to different platforms.
Solid understanding of Marketing principles and audience targeting to support brand awareness and business growth.
Excellent Communication skills, including clear writing, stakeholder coordination, and professional collaboration.
Experience using social media analytics tools and insights to optimize campaigns and content performance.
Prior experience in influencer marketing, community management, or brand partnerships is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred.
Familiarity with the Bahrain market and interest in local entrepreneurship, innovation
